title: TYPOGRAFIE
slide_intent: Choose related type families for different media so readers encounter a consistent voice without losing readability.
strategic_value: The DB Neo, Screen and Office families can maintain a recognizable expression across daily communications.
demonstration: A large heading introduces three related type families and the addition of DB Neo Extra Wide.
practical_value: Choose a family appropriate to analog, digital or office use.

content_islands.name: Introduction
content_islands.spec: Place the uppercase heading above the explanatory paragraph.

reference_purposes.Intent: The paragraph connects the three families to accessibility, functionality and distinctive expression.
reference_purposes.Application: It distinguishes DB Neo, DB Neo Screen and DB Neo Office.
